```sql
SELECT 
    region,
    net_revenue_eur
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
WHERE 
    order_date_local = '2026-01-01'
    AND region IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    region;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM placed_at) = 2025
GROUP BY 
    region
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    region, 
    COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders
WHERE 
    order_date >= '2026-05-01' 
    AND order_date < '2026-06-01'
GROUP BY 
    region
ORDER BY 
    order_count DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE placed_at >= '2026-05-01' AND placed_at < '2026-06-01';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    p.category,
    SUM(ol.quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM 
    analytics.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 
    ol.order_id IN (
        SELECT order_id 
        FROM analytics.fct_orders 
        WHERE placed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND placed_at < '2026-01-01'
    )
GROUP BY 
    p.category
ORDER BY 
    total_units_sold DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM analytics.fct_orders o
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.placed_at) = 2025;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.country,
    SUM(o.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders o
WHERE 
    o.placed_at >= '2025-01-01' 
    AND o.placed_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    o.country
ORDER BY 
    net_revenue DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(amount_eur) AS total_refunded_eur
FROM analytics.fct_refunds
WHERE order_month >= '2026-03-01' AND order_month < '2026-04-01';
```
